option_relations.rationale: The option 'Chondroma' directly matches the leaf label 'Chondroma' (B1.1), indicating a direct equivalence in clinical entity.

The option 'Low-grade chondrosarcoma of the temporal bone' is a subtype of the broader category that could include the leaf 'Low-grade chondrosarcoma of the temporal bone' (B2.1), given the specific location and nature of the tumor.

The option 'Low-grade chondrosarcoma of the mastoid with facial nerve involvement' is closely related to both 'Low-grade chondrosarcoma of the temporal bone' (B2.1) and specifically to 'Low-grade Chondrosarcoma of the Temporal Bone with Facial Nerve Involvement' (B4.3), considering the involvement of the facial nerve and the specific location.
The option 'Benign chondroma' is equivalent to the leaf 'Chondroma' (B1.1), as both refer to a benign cartilaginous tumor.
